name: comp-546

frames.best_why: Full four-photo grid with the Add more button and one X per image, cursor out of the way.
frames.render_note: Crop cuts the left of the "Uploaded Files" heading and the grid's left edge.

tagline: Grid of uploaded photos, each with a small remove button.
summary: A dashed dark container holding a three-column grid of square image thumbnails under an Uploaded Files count. Add more opens the file picker, and a round X on each photo removes it.
appearance: Four square black-and-white photos sit in a two-row grid, one column short, inside a dashed rounded frame. Above them a truncated heading reads Files (4) beside a small outlined Add more button, and each photo carries a tiny dark circle with an X at its top-right.
behaviour: Dragging files over the container tints it, thumbnails fill the grid up to six, and pressing a photo's X drops it out. The recorded frames only show the finished four-photo state with the pointer drifting.
demo_content: Four black-and-white photos of buildings, balloons, dunes and a beach; the caption links to an API doc.
search_phrases: upload several images into a grid
gallery of uploaded pictures with remove buttons
drag and drop a batch of photos
add more images to an upload list
image attachment grid in a form
remove a photo from the upload area
bulk image uploader with x buttons
use_when: Several images go up together, such as product photos or gallery attachments.
avoid_when: Thumbnails are square crops, and the six-file cap with a 5MB-per-file limit are fixed in the source.
customise: The six-file cap, the 5MB limit, accepted formats and four Unsplash seed photos are written in the file; grid columns are classes to change.
weight_why: Four remote thumbnails and a hidden file input; no animation loop.

a11y.note: Add more and each remove button are labelled and focusable, but the drop area itself has no keyboard path.

issues: The crop cuts off the start of the "Uploaded Files" heading and clips the left column.
The frames never show a photo being added or removed, only the finished grid.
The caption is developer copy ending in an API link.
polish_why: Tidy photo grid with neat remove badges, but the clipped header and dev caption let it down.
